About

Meet Sara and Dillon

We started Tradition Local to help people feel connected to their neighborhood, community, and city.

Photo of Sara coming soon

Writer and reviewer

Sara

Sara visits the places she writes about, then shares what she found, honestly and kindly. Her ratings are a big part of how Tradition Local helps neighbors decide where to eat, shop, and spend a Saturday.

How we review places
Photo of Dillon coming soon

Realtor and neighbor

Dillon Loren

Dillon is a Realtor with Tradition Realty Group at Keller Williams Memorial. He founded Tradition Realty Group in 2016 and has about ten years of experience helping families and young couples find a place that fits.

He grew up in a family business in the hospitality industry, and he has lived in Houston since he was young.
